label: llm-request demo
info:
Demonstrates the llm-request node: msg.payload goes to the LLM, the reply comes back on msg.payload.

SETUP:
1. Configure the LLM Plugin in the editor sidebar first (provider, API key if needed).
2. Set a model on both llm-request nodes (or pass msg.model).
3. Deploy, then click an inject button and watch the debug sidebar.

TOP ROW: a plain question.

BOTTOM ROW: the same node with a System prompt set on it, so every request is answered under those instructions. msg.system overrides it per message.

STATUS: while a request runs the node shows a blue dot with the elapsed seconds, then green on success or red on error or timeout. The timeout defaults to 3600 seconds (1 hour) because local LLMs can be slow; lower it on the node or via msg.timeout to fail fast.

name: a question
payload: Explain what Node-RED is in one sentence.

name: a sentence to translate
payload: Node-RED is a low-code tool for wiring together devices and services.

name: translate to Japanese
systemPrompt: Translate the user's text into Japanese. Reply with the translation only.
